task: Genre research wave: biomech/demolition-derby/FlatOut/Gundam/Transformers for theyard; Hitman/007/GoldenEye spy games for Hired Gun; GTA-likes/One-State-likes for Urban Mayhem; hero franchises/Super City for M-Hero — each as a GENRE_RESEARCH.md doc in the game's repo
resume_brief: Genre research wave coordinator. Four lanes, each producing a GENRE_RESEARCH.md doc committed on a research/genre-study-<game> branch (pushed, NOT merged — owning build coordinators merge): (1) THEYARD (~/workspace/game-sweep/theyard/docs/GENRE_RESEARCH.md): biomech games, demolition derby games with FlatOut series deep dive ('fkstout' interpreted as FlatOut), Gundam-style mecha games, Transformers-style games ('transgor' interpreted as Transformers) — mechanics, customization systems, art direction, production lessons, plus synthesis: concrete recommendations for theyard's mecha customizer + derby/racing production. (2) HIRED GUN: Hitman/007/GoldenEye-style stealth-action spy games and their inspirations — determine Hired Gun's location first (own repo/prototype vs inside ~/workspace/urban-mayhem-port, whose AGENTS.md names it); write the doc to the right repo's docs/ (HIRED_GUN_GENRE_RESEARCH.md if inside urban-mayhem-port). (3) URBAN MAYHEM (~/workspace/urban-mayhem-port/docs/GENRE_RESEARCH.md): GTA and GTA-likes, One State and mobile GTA-likes — open-world systems, mobile constraints, production scope lessons for a UE5 mobile open world. (4) M-HERO (~/workspace/game-sweep/M-Hero-Simulator-/docs/GENRE_RESEARCH.md): superhero games/franchises and MDickie's Super City specifically — powers systems, hero customization, production lessons for rehabilitating the broken prototype. Every doc: key titles, systems worth stealing, art direction, production/scope lessons, synthesis with concrete recommendations for that game, sources cited. No invented facts about real games — distinguish researched fact from recommendation. Standing rules: branch->PR (no direct main pushes), heartbeat this checkpoint, disk <=75% save-before-delete.
